notes:
{促進|そくしん} means to promote, encourage, or accelerate something. Widely used in business, policy, and health contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a noun or する verb ({促進|そくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to promote).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧{促進|そくしん}: sales promotion
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{促進|そくしん}: health promotion
- ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧{促進|そくしん}: promoting understanding
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧{促進|そくしん}: growth promotion
- ⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧{促進|そくしん}: digestive aid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {促進|そくしん}: promotion (making something happen faster)
- ⟦{推進|すいしん}→推進：12908_suishin⟧: promotion (driving forward, advocacy)
- ⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧: to urge, to encourage (verb)

⟦{販促|はんそく}→販促：17109_hansoku⟧ (short for ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧{促進|そくしん}) is common in marketing.
